root_cause: Seed derivation in deersRockAdapter used parseInt(id.replace(/\D/g, '')) which extracts only digits. All hospital IDs (jkt-001, bdo-001, etc.) have the same numeric suffix '001', so all sentinels got the same RNG seed, breaking determinism guarantees.
trace_summary: Built 30-hospital configs, tested unique seeds, discovered all seeds were identical due to numeric extraction. Fixed by replacing with string hash (djb2 variant) of the full ID.

failure_signature.verifier_cause: Test 'each sentinel has unique derived seed' failed — expected 27 unique seeds but got 2
failure_signature.agent_behavior: Used parseInt on the ID string assuming the numeric suffix would be unique per hospital
failure_signature.agent_mechanism: Did not verify seed uniqueness across the full config set before committing to the derivation strategy; assumed the naming convention guaranteed unique numbers
